list.title: Events
list.description: Upcoming community events — RSVP and join in.
list.filterEmpty: Nothing here for this filter right now.

detail.shareFailedHint: Your browser allows neither sharing nor copying. Open the event and copy the link from the address bar.
detail.loginToSee: Sign in to see who is going
detail.noAttendees: No RSVPs yet — be the first!

rsvp.fullHint: All spots are taken. Check back later — people do withdraw their RSVP sometimes.
rsvp.failedHint: Your answer never reached the server. Click again; if it keeps failing, reload the page.
rsvp.ticketRequiredHint: Open the event and buy a ticket there — then you can RSVP.

admin.title: Events
admin.empty: No events yet — create the first one.
admin.savedDraftHint: It sits in the list as a draft and nobody can see it yet. Publish it from the row menu.
admin.saveFailedHint: Nothing you typed is lost — the form stays open. Check your connection and save again.
admin.publishedHint: It is now in the public event list and guests can RSVP.
admin.unpublishedHint: Only you still see it here in the dashboard. RSVPs given so far are kept.
admin.cancelledHint: The event stays in the list — that is how attendees get to see the cancellation.
admin.confirmCancelText: “{title}” will show as cancelled for everyone. Registered guests see the cancellation right away.
admin.actionFailedHint: Nothing about the event changed. Reload the page and try again.

form.title: Title
form.capacityHelp: Maximum number of attendees — leave empty for unlimited.
form.urlHelp: Paste a link from Google Meet, Jitsi, Twitch, YouTube, OwnCast or LinkedIn Live — any URL works.
form.replayHelp: Set after the event — shows up as “Watch replay” in the archive.
form.coverHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP, max. 2 MB. Without a cover a theme color block is rendered.
form.descriptionHelp: Markdown is supported — **bold**, lists with - or 1., links.
form.addressHelp: Full address — linked as a Google Maps link (“How to find us”).
form.locationNotesHelp: If the venue is hard to find — shown on the event page.
form.accessHelp: Paid events require a ticket — checkout arrives with the Stripe integration (phase 23).
form.priceLookupKeyHelp: Points at the price in Stripe (called “lookup_key” there) — the amount THERE is what counts, not the one entered here.
form.priceLookupKeyPattern: Only keys matching this pattern are allowed: {patterns}. Any other key is rejected at checkout.
form.recurrenceHelp: Creates real individual dates (rolling ~4 months ahead) — each date is independent afterwards.

admin.coverFailedHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 2 MB are allowed. If the image fits, just try again.
admin.coverRemoveFailedHint: The image is still there. Reload the page and try again.
admin.stopSeriesText: All FUTURE dates of this series will be cancelled (attendees see the cancellation). Past dates stay unchanged. No new dates will be created.

validation.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
validation.urlInvalid: Link is not a valid URL.
validation.paidNeedsLookupKey: Paid events need a Stripe lookup_key.

vote.failedHint: Your vote never arrived. Click again.

ticket.alreadyOwned: You already own a ticket for this event.
ticket.failed: Could not start the ticket checkout.
ticket.failedHint: The checkout did not open — nothing was charged. Please try again in a moment.

reasons.scam: A scam — this event does not exist

moderation.title: Moderate events
moderation.hiddenHint: Nobody but moderation can see it any more — the cover image included. Open reports about it are now closed.
moderation.actionFailedHint: Nothing about the event changed. Reload the page and try again.
moderation.empty: This is where the published events of this community show up. Reported ones carry a flag.
